name: Compute Cluster S62: Cointegration & Pairs Trading Pipeline
description: Tests: engle_granger(window), half_life_ar1(window), rolling_adf(window). Full pairs pipeline: cointegration test → spread → half-life → z-score trading.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S62: Cointegration & Pairs Trading
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

ref = reference_stocks(ticker="QQQ")()
ref_close = ref.c

# === ENGLE-GRANGER COINTEGRATION TEST ===
eg = engle_granger(window=200)(close, ref_close)
spread = eg.spread
hedge_ratio = eg.hedge_ratio
pval = eg.p_value
is_coint = eg.is_cointegrated

# === HALF-LIFE OF MEAN REVERSION ===
hl = half_life_ar1(window=100)(spread)
half_life = hl.half_life
is_mr = hl.is_mean_reverting

# === ROLLING ADF ON SPREAD ===
adf = rolling_adf(window=100)(spread)
adf_pval = adf.p_value
is_stat = adf.is_stationary

# === Z-SCORE FOR ENTRY SIGNALS ===
spread_z = zscore(window=20)(spread)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Cointegration Spread',
    category='Cointegration',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Spread', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=spread)

xy_lines(
    title='Spread Z-Score (Entry/Exit Signal)',
    category='Cointegration',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Z-Score', color=Color.Purple)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=spread_z)

xy_lines(
    title='Rolling ADF p-value',
    category='Stationarity',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='p-value', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=adf_pval)

xy_lines(
    title='Half-Life (bars)',
    category='Mean Reversion',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Half-Life', color=Color.Green)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=half_life)
